# awx_team_associate_role (Resource)

Associates an AWX role with an AWX team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_team_associate_role" "team_role_admin_org" {
  team_id = awx_team.team_role.id
  role_id = data.awx_organization_object_roles.org_role.roles["Execute"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (Number) Database ID of the role to assign.
- `team_id` (Number) Database ID for this Team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <team_id>/<role_id>
import {
  to = awx_team_associate_role.example
  id = "1/2"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <team_id>/<role_id>
terraform import awx_team_associate_role.example 1/2
```
